rounds.question: How many taxis available for hire will SSA count inside the Downtown Core planning area (URA Master Plan 2019 boundary) in LTA's Taxi Availability snapshot for Friday 2026-12-11 23:00 Singapore time? Free taxis are those not hired and not busy, so a lower number means higher demand. SSA sets and resolves this metric; no publisher releases it.
rounds.resolve: SSA's archived snapshot of the keyless data.gov.sg Taxi Availability endpoint (api.data.gov.sg/v1/transport/taxi-availability?date_time=2026-12-11T23:00:00), captured Friday 23:30 SGT under sources/lta-rt/taxi/, metric definition v1 of card sg-taxi-downtown-fri2300@v2: valid if the timestamp is at most 120 s before the minute and the island count is at least 30% of the median of the last 4 valid Fridays, otherwise the minutes 23:01, 23:02, 23:05, 23:10 in turn; points counted in DOWNTOWN CORE of the pinned URA boundary (sha256 f23856251b46...). No valid snapshot among the five minutes: cancelled. Contains information accessed from data.gov.sg under the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0.
